title: feat(media): strip image metadata on upload with safe=privacy
author: fisventurous

gist.summary: Media uploads can opt into image metadata stripping with `safe=privacy`, the `Pollinations-Safe: privacy` header, or `safe=true`. It removes supported metadata such as GPS location, camera details, and embedded text before storage while retaining orientation and colour profiles. The option works with multipart, JSON (including image data URLs), and raw image uploads; without it, upload bytes are preserved. Privacy-processed images are limited to 32 MiB (`413` if exceeded), unreadable images return `400`, and successful processing adds `X-Safety-Applied: privacy` to the response.
